Emerging markets stocks are on fire:

Emerging stock markets have seen 10 consecutive monthly gains, the longest streak in 21 years.

This has now surpassed the 8-month run seen in 2017.

In other words, EM stocks have not seen even a single month of negative returns this year, the first such occurrence since 1993.

During this time, the MSCI Emerging Markets Index has surged +30.3%, its best YTD performance since 2017.

EM equities are now on track for their 3rd consecutive annual gain, also the best streak since 2017.

The global bull market is expanding.
